reviews.review: nice

Honestly, I didn't expect much at first as a game which from screenshots I've seen being mostly dialogue. This is my first JRPG and I can say that P5R really shows how far you can really push an RPG. 
I'm about 25% done with the game with 30 hours and I can say for myself its amazing.

Now for why it is amazing, the music... its beautiful, the GUI and UI are so stylish and unique it just feels cool even scrolling around settings and menus. 
It is a turn-based combat game which I usually don't really like but P5R adds so much life to it that make the turn-based combat less repetitive (it can get repetitive).
The story is excellent, the characters are written well and likable etc... 

However, I find that sometimes palaces can get tedious and annoying (skill issue on my part).
Sometimes dialogue can get frustratingly long and annoying (this is not a usual case) and with turn-based combat which can again become repetitive. 

Overall, 8/10 for recommending to others as some people may not be built to play P5R and experience true level of peak.

This is the first Persona game I have ever played, and it truly exceeded my blind expectations. The plot, the character development, the cast, and especially the music, the soundtrack is something I will never get tired of. It never bore me no matter how long I played and even though it’s a turn based game I didn’t mind at all.

The Palaces each have their own unique puzzles and bosses, and everything about them feels well thought out. What is even more mind blowing the deeper you go is the story itself, which is surely life changing. This was my first playthrough with no prior knowledge of the game. I simply went with the flow, using strategic plays and patient grinding, which helped me understand the game’s mechanics more as I progressed.

Thank you Phantom Thieves for stealing my heart. It was truly everything I expected and more. The Trickster strikes again.
